subject: Mutual action plan: Eval dataset delivery, gated access, and close timeline
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightcart.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP + dataset handoff plan for evaluation

Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the BrightCart ML team is ready to run a short evaluation. Procurement asked me to get a single mutual action plan (MAP) that spells out exactly what you’ll provide, how we get sandbox access, and a close/acceptance timeline we can attach to our PO. Key asks from our side:

- Delivery: sample eval dataset (up to 50k rows) + a 10-case promptpack and README
- Access: ephemeral sandbox credentials, token limits and rotation cadence
- Usage constraints: no external redistribution, retention window, and deletion confirmation
- Acceptance gates: QC pass, sample eval script, and a 14-day test window

Can you send a proposed MAP and a timeline (dates) so we can align legal/procurement?

Attn: Daniel Cho (ML lead) & BrightCart procurement team.

Thanks,
Daniel
Lead ML Engineer
BrightCart

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + dataset handoff plan for evaluation

Daniel — appreciate the clear list. Draft MAP attached (redwood-map-brightcart-v1.xlsx) and a short promptpack README (promptpack-sample-README.md). High-level proposal below; attached file has dates and acceptance checklist in a table so procurement/legal can reference it.

Summary (proposed):
- Day 0 (Oct 20): Redwood shares dataset sample (.csv) and promptpack README via restricted Drive link; delivery covered by MPA clause 1.
- Day 1: BrightCart receives ephemeral sandbox credentials (time-limited GCP service account) and instructions. Keys rotate every 72 hours; token usage throttle set to 10 requests/sec and 10k tokens/day during evaluation.
- Day 2-16 (14-day test window): BrightCart runs their eval scripts. Redwood will provide a test harness (small runner) and a QC checklist.
- Day 17: BrightCart submits QC pass/failure and notes. If QC pass, both parties sign off and Redwood issues acceptance confirmation + one-week follow-up for retention deletion confirmation.

Usage constraints we propose (also in the sheet):
- No redistribution or rehosting of raw samples outside the ephemeral sandbox.
- Retention: delete local copies within 30 days of acceptance; audit log proof required.
- Allowed use: model evaluation only; no further training without written permission.

Open items for procurement/legal (we flagged these in the sheet):
- Addendum for SOC2 evidence transfer (if BrightCart needs logs).
- NDA/MPA signature flow: DocuSign link preferred; we can accept BrightCart PO as trigger if legal confirms.

Attachments: redwood-map-brightcart-v1.xlsx (MAP + acceptance checklist), promptpack-sample-README.md (sample prompt pack + run instructions).

Next step: Karthik, Marissa — would you confirm the security gating language and token limits? If OK, I’ll send to procurement with dates.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + dataset handoff plan for evaluation

Monica — reviewed. A couple of security tweaks I recommend before procurement signs:

1) Data residency: confirm that the sample extraction will originate from our US region only and that no backups are retained outside the sandbox. Add explicit clause in MAP cell A6.
2) Key rotation: 72-hour rotation is fine, but we should add one emergency rotation trigger (Redwood or BrightCart detected compromise).
3) Audit logs: we will provide request-level logs for the evaluation window; BrightCart can request a redacted export (PII removed) limited to the test window.
4) Redaction checklist: include an automated scan step before delivery to scrub customer PII; note this in the sheet and in the README.

Marissa — on token limits: I propose a soft cap of 10k tokens/day and a hard cap of 20k tokens/day with automatic throttling and an email alert to the BrightCart admin once soft cap is exceeded. That will let them run bursts but keep costs predictable.

If BrightCart agrees, I’ll add these lines to the MAP and to the sample delivery manifest.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + dataset handoff plan for evaluation

All — quick operational notes from the evaluation ops side:

- Promptpack README includes a small runner (python) and sample golden outputs. We’ll not ship the full seed corpus; only the 10-case promptpack and a 500-row sample CSV.
- Acceptance tests: we’ll provide a pass/fail script that checks for exact formatting, tokenization parity, and two smoke checks (latency < 500ms p50 on our hosted infra; model consistency checks).
- Ownership of results: BrightCart can keep evaluation result artifacts (metrics, logs) but must not publish raw sample data. Please confirm we can require a deletion confirmation within 30 days after acceptance.

I’ve updated the attached sheet (redwood-map-brightcart-v1.xlsx) with the ops checklist and the exact files we will push to Drive.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: promptpack-sample-README.md (text), redwood-map-brightcart-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Cc: procurement@brightcart.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + dataset handoff plan for evaluation

Monica/Karthik/Marissa — thanks for the speedy turnaround and the level of detail. Procurement reviewed the MAP and the only edits they requested were:

- Explicitly list the deletion confirmation format (we agree to a signed .pdf confirmation from BrightCart admin).
- Add a clause that model access keys will be disabled automatically on Day 18 (one day after the 14-day window) unless extension requested in writing.

We agree to the token caps and the redaction step. Please send a DocuSign link for the MPA (we can countersign) and upload the sample files to the Drive folder. Once we have the signed MPA + dataset in the restricted Drive, we’ll kick off the test on Oct 21.

Also attaching a signed internal PO number here as reference (PO# BR-PO-3356).

Best,
Daniel Cho
Lead ML Engineer
BrightCart

Attachments referenced by BrightCart: signed-mpa-2026-10-18.pdf (will be DocuSigned after Redwood sends link)
